raw_text: China Caught Manipulating Satellite Imagery to Frame India for LAC Violations. Bellingcat and independent OSINT analysts have confirmed that satellite imagery circulated by Chinese state-affiliated accounts showing alleged Indian military construction along the LAC was digitally manipulated. Error level analysis revealed structures spliced from other locations into genuine Maxar imagery. India's defence ministry called the campaign a deliberate attempt to manufacture justification for Chinese military buildup near the disputed border.
clean_text: Hindustan Times reports Bellingcat and OSINT analysts confirmed Chinese manipulation of LAC satellite imagery. Structures spliced from other locations. India's defence ministry calls it justification for Chinese military buildup.
